6. Which among the following compounds possesses trivalent cation and
divalent negative radical?
(a) Calcium sulphide
(b) Aluminium nitrate
(c) Aluminium chromate
(d) Cupric hydroxide

7. The volume of a given mass of gas is 400 mL at 3 atm pressure. Calculate the
new volume when pressure increases by 15% at constant temperature.
(a) 337 mL (b) 347 mL
(c) 327 mL (d) 357 mL

8. Which among the following possesses the least weight?
(a) $15 \times 10^{22}$ molecules of $\mathrm{O}_2$
(b) 0.15 moles of $\mathrm{SO}_3$
(c) 2.24 L of $\mathrm{SO}_2$ at STP
(d) $24 \times 10^{22}$ atoms of He

9. 1 mole of a hydrocarbon requires maximum volume of oxygen for complete
combustion under the same conditions. Identify the hydrocarbon.
(a) $\mathrm{CH}_4$ (b) $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_6$ (c) $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_6$ (d) $\mathrm{C}_4\mathrm{H}_6$

10. Calculate the volume of $\mathrm{CO}_2$ required for the complete combustion of 30 g
of coke at STP, if the percentage conversion is 80%.
(a) 44.8 L (b) 50.4 L (c) 56 L (d) 61.6 L

11. The empirical formula of a compound is $\mathrm{CH}_4\mathrm{N}$. The empirical formula mass
of the compound is equal to its vapour density. Which among the following
compounds possesses the same number of carbon atoms as present in the
above compound?
(a) $\mathrm{Na}_2\mathrm{CO}_3$ (b) $\mathrm{Ca}(\mathrm{HCO}_3)_2$
(c) $\mathrm{Al}_2(\mathrm{CO}_3)_3$ (d) $\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{HCO}_3)_3$

12. Which among the following is associated with same volume ratio of reac-
tants as the formation of $\text{SO}_3$ from $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$?
(a) Synthesis of hydrogen chloride from $\text{H}_2$ and $\text{Cl}_2$.
(b) Formation of $\text{CO}_2$ from $\text{CO}$ and $\text{O}_2$.
(c) Formation of $\text{NH}_3$ from its constituents.
(d) Synthesis of nitrogen monoxide from its constituents.
